Proposals are changes a dream may not make itself and proposed instead,
for now to the skip list (agent index skip). list shows the pending ones
(--all every one), with what was seen and its sources; accept makes the
change (and tells a running index watcher) and records who accepted it;
reject records the no and why. Accepting and rejecting are a person's:
an agent's run of either prompts its person, and a dream's agent is
refused.

Usage:
  agent dream proposals [flags]
  agent dream proposals [command]

Examples:
  agent dream proposals list
  agent dream proposals accept 3
  agent dream proposals reject 4 --note "build/ holds sources in that repo"

Available Commands:
  list        List the pending proposals (--all: every one)
  accept      Accept a proposal: make the change (a person)
  reject      Reject a proposal (a person)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for proposals

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent dream proposals [command] --help" for more information about a command.
